text.description_html:
Acorn RISBP, 18-7/8" Bean Tip Iron Strap Hinge With Pintle

Designed for gates 3" to 4" thick weighing up to 250 pounds, the 18-7/8" Bean Tip Rough Iron Strap Hinge With Carriage Bolts measures 18-7/8" long. This Acorn made iron strap hinge will be sure to add an authentic old world finishing touch to any door. The 18-7/8" Bean Tip Strap Hinge With Pintle has a rough iron finish which duplicates that found on the ironwork of many old European castles and cathedrals by imitating the texture of naturally weathered of iron. It comes packaged with carriage bolts.

Also Available: 15-5/8" Bean Tip Rough Iron Strap Hinge With Carriage Bolts or Click Here to see the entire Acorn Bean Tip Collection

Features of the Acorn Rough Iron Bean Tip Strap Hinge:

  • Finish: Rough Black Iron
  • For exterior and interior use.
  • Packaged with black finish carriage bolts.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty

Specifications of the Rough Iron Bean Tip Strap Hinge with Carriage Bolts:

  • Designed for gates 3" - 4" inches thick up to 250 lbs.
  • Length: 18-7/8"
  • Width: 1-9/16"
  • Gauge: .187
  • Pintle: 5-1/2"

Sold Individually
